detections.sql:
SELECT 
  le.country AS region, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS success_count, 
  COUNT(*) AS total_count, 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS success_rate
FROM 
  transactions t 
  JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id 
  JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id
WHERE 
  t.status = 'COMPLETED' 
  AND le.country IS NOT NULL 
  AND u.account_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
  le.country
HAVING 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 < 80

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN t1.user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t2.txn_count END) AS avg_txn_per_user, 
       u.full_name, 
       u.user_id, 
       t2.txn_count AS current_txn_count, 
       t1.txn_count AS previous_txn_count 
FROM users u 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS txn_count 
           FROM transactions 
           WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') 
           GROUP BY user_id) t1 
ON u.user_id = t1.user_id 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS txn_count 
           FROM transactions 
           WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-30 days') 
           GROUP BY user_id) t2 
ON u.user_id = t2.user_id 
WHERE u.account_status = 'ACTIVE'
